issues.problem: Context 6 (人生哪能{万事如意}？) fits 一帆风顺 from the same set just as well (人生哪能一帆风顺 is equally idiomatic).
issues.action: Replaced with a dialogue greeting listing work and family, then summing up with 万事如意, where the all-round wish is the natural fit.

issues.problem: Context 5 (只要你开口，我{心甘情愿}帮你这个忙) involves no cost or sacrifice, so it reads as a plain 'gladly' and is unnatural for this idiom.
issues.action: Replaced with 这是我自己选的路，再苦再累我也{心甘情愿}。, which shows a hardship freely accepted, in predicate position.

issues.problem: lit was garbled ('a big fright, with big and one set around the word for surprise').
issues.action: Rewrote lit to explain the image clearly: 'eat' one big shock, the word for 'be startled' split by 'big' and 'one'.

issues.problem: Context 6 used 不是{一言为定}了吗, an awkward aspectual form for a sealing formula.
issues.action: Rewrote as 上次我们不是说好了“{一言为定}”吗？, quoting the formula as it is actually said.

issues.problem: Story checked: 《文心雕龙·体性》 says of Xi Kang (叔夜) 俊侠，故兴高而采烈; details and source are right.
